description: List the appointment reservations (1:1 services) of one member. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/appointments.

endAfter.description: Only appointments ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only appointments ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startAfter.description: Only appointments starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only appointments starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

name: momence_list_member_appointments
title: List a member's appointments
